export_evidence: ImportKey India page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/arb-bearings-limited) shows 5 shipment rows, e.g. "2022-07-03 | ARB BEARINGS LIMITED | ATIF ASIM & CO. | TECNOPART BRAND TAPER ROLLER BEARING | Pipavab, India | PKKHI, Pakistan | 730050.0 | DEL300317B00" and "2022-06-24 | ARB BEARINGS LIMITED | GORMINA MARKETING | ARB BRAND TAPER ROLLER BEARINGS | Mundra, India | EGPSD, Egypt | 730050.0 | DEL30H922B00". Source counter: page advertises 'Shipments available for ARB BEARINGS LIMITED, refreshed daily'; rows actually seen = 5 (dates 2022-06-17 to 2022-07-03), destinations Pakistan (Karachi) and Egypt (Port Said), B/L numbers DEL300317B00, DEL30C203200, DEL30C779100, DEL30H922B00, DEL3017B3200.
note: Export shipments are factually confirmed with dates, destinations and B/L numbers, but the HS codes printed in the customs rows are 730050.0 and 870006.0 (pipe fittings / vehicle parts), not the declared 848210/848220 (ball and taper roller bearings) — the goods descriptions are bearings, so the declared HS appears to be the correct product code and the customs-row codes look like data artefacts; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected with the declared 848210;848220 retained as the factual product code. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and tofler.in, zaubacorp.com, volza.com and the company site arbbearings.com all returned 403/404, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are null — not public/not retrievable in this session, not evidence of absence.
